AssertionError: b're:agent: a small, readable agent harness

usage:
  reagent run  [flags] "prompt"    one task, then exit
  reagent chat [flags]             a conversation, one turn per line
  reagent help [run|chat]          this text, or a command's flags
  reagent version                  the build's version
  reagent login                    sign in with ChatGPT
  reagent logout                   disconnect ChatGPT
  reagent auth status              account, plan usage, expiry and models

examples:
  reagent chat --workspace ./repo
  reagent run --workspace ./repo "Set the default timeout to 30s."
  reagent run --workspace . --show-context "Where is the budget?" | jq .

environment:
  OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY   credentials, read only for a live run
  API_PROXY_URL, API_PROXY_PROVIDER   send OpenAI requests to this full URL instead,
                                      with no key; the provider must be openai
  TYPESAFE_API_KEY                    optional router key; read only when Auto is enabled
  REAGENT_MODEL                       default model
  REAGENT_OPENAI_AUTH                 auto, key or chatgpt (--openai-auth overrides)
  REAGENT_OPENAI_BASE_URL             inference API base URL (default https://api.openai.com/v1)
  REAGENT_OPENAI_AUTH_ISSUER          OAuth issuer (default https://auth.openai.com)
  REAGENT_ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL          Messages API base URL (default https://api.anthropic.com/v1)
  REAGENT_JEV_BASE_URL                Jev API base URL (default https://api.typesafe.ai/v1)
  REAGENT_RESPONSE_HEADER_TIMEOUT     header timeout in whole seconds, 1\xe2\x80\x933600 (default 600)
  REAGENT_RESPONSE_IDLE_TIMEOUT       body-idle timeout in whole seconds, 1\xe2\x80\x933600 (default 300)
  REAGENT_WORKSPACE_GIT_TIMEOUT       workspace-snapshot Git probe timeout in whole seconds, 1\xe2\x80\x933600 (default 2)
  REAGENT_CONTEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS       positive testing window cap; saved across resume
  REAGENT_CONTEXT_GC_AGE_STEPS        GC experiment: 0 disables, integer > 3 enables
  REAGENT_CONTEXT_GC_CONSOLIDATE      GC experiment: true, false, 1 or 0; default false
                                      experiments are exclusive and require --context-gc
                                      empty is unset; validated on resume, saved settings win
  NO_COLOR                            turn off styling
'
